steps.text: Complete Tutorial Island

steps.title: (Optional) If you want an easier …
steps.text: (Optional) If you want an easier and safer early game, consider utilizing the boneyard method or early blue dragons (slower but less tedious) to get 43 Prayer right at the start of your account. The guide is written assuming you don't do this so if you want to jump right into the action you can skip it.
steps.note: Offer bones at a gilded altar in a POH with both incense burners lit (fastest); Chaos altar in the Wilderness is ~half the cost.
